name: banyandb
description: Report profile for incoming pull requests to apache/skywalking-banyandb. metrics.sandbox.go.buildTags is querymetrics, as the repository's own CI passes (.github/workflows/test-integration-standalone.yml runs the integration tests with --tags querymetrics; QLB-T02 asserts it). metrics.sandbox.go.ginkgoLabelFilter is !slow, the --label-filter that workflow passes to ginkgo (a 60-minute job); go.sh gives it, as -ginkgo.label-filter, only to touched packages whose tests import Ginkgo. The go test timeout follows metrics.sandbox.go.wallClockMs (30 minutes) less 2 minutes, not go test's default 10. metrics.sandbox.go.image is golang:1.26.10 (go.mod needs go 1.26.x), pinned by digest; refresh it with docker pull and docker image inspect when go.mod moves. The report.sections routing globs follow the repository's layout as the design maps it (design-pr-review-graph.md 6.2) and are TO CONFIRM against the repository before a live run; a glob that matches nothing only means less routing, the generic detectors still run. questions.designDocs names the design and architecture pages (docs/concept and the 0.12.0 streaming and batch designs) that the necessity question N1 reads for what the system says about the behavior a change touches; it was checked against docs/ in apache/skywalking-banyandb at 450c73a3a, so refresh it when those pages move.

argv: want=$(sed -n "s/^go //p" go.mod); have=$(go env GOVERSION) || exit 127; [ "$have" = "go$want" ] || { echo "$have found; go.mod needs go$want" >&2; exit 1; }

c="${GRAPHLOOM_CODEX_BIN:-codex}"; h="${GRAPHLOOM_CODEX_HOME:-${CODEX_HOME:-}}"; [ -z "$h" ] || export CODEX_HOME="$h"; "$c" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Codex ($c) is not installed" >&2; exit 127; }; "$c" login status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Codex is not logged in${h:+ for $h}: run $c login" >&2; exit 1; }

c="${GRAPHLOOM_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"; d="${GRAPHLOOM_CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-}}"; [ -z "$d" ] || export CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$d"; "$c" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Claude Code ($c) is not installed" >&2; exit 127; }; "$c" auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Claude Code is not logged in${d:+ for $d}: run $c auth login" >&2; exit 1; }

sections.meaning: Proto and API definitions, the schema catalog, storage and on-disk format.
Schedulers, flushers, compaction and merge, retention.
CLI flags (cobra/pflag), environment variables, config files.
gRPC services and messages, the HTTP gateway, BydbQL syntax.
Go modules, the UI's npm packages, Docker images.

argv: set -eu; export BUF_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/buf-cache; mkdir -p "$BUF_CACHE_DIR"; cp -R --no-preserve=mode "$GRAPHLOOM_MOUNT_BUF_CACHE/." "$BUF_CACHE_DIR/"; cd api; PATH="$GRAPHLOOM_MOUNT_TOOLS:$PWD/proto:$PATH" "$GRAPHLOOM_MOUNT_TOOLS/buf" generate
set -eu; mkdir -p /tmp/genbin; go build -o /tmp/genbin/mockgen go.uber.org/mock/mockgen; PATH="/tmp/genbin:$PATH" go generate ./...
